bindings.detail: This node is typed as Google Sheets but carries "databaseId", which is not a parameter that node has - it belongs to a different n8n node. The node will import, show none of these fields, and do nothing useful. Replace it with the node the parameters imply, or with a Google Sheets node configured from scratch. This is a defect in the template; tell us and we will fix or refund it.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Emails" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Emails, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-emails.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'mql' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'sql' arm ends at Fast-Track 'sql' + Alert, which posts a Slack message to #sales. The 'mql' arm goes to Delegate 'mql' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Mql Lead - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Mql Lead before relying on that arm.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Daily Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId

Open each of: Archive Row Snapshot, Load Previous Snapshot, Mark Completed in Google Sheets, Park in Dead-Letter Queue and pick the real documentId from the list.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URLs "api.example.com", "enrichment.example.com" are illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace them with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Research Specialist" and select it on Research Specialist (Sub-workflow)
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Research Specialist, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-research-specialist.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Research Specialist (Sub-workflow) and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.
